style.backgroundSystem: deep-space starfield #0D1230 with glowing planet or earth horizon backdrops; dark matte panels #101736 for info cards and macro shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-space sci-fi streetwear sneaker visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep-space navy #0D1230, aurora indigo #2A2260, starlight white #F2F6FF and neon cyan accent #3DE8FF, with the shoe's own teal-green product accent #17977C left to the product reference; cool cosmic studio lighting with cyan-white rim light and soft neon glow fill, controlled soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines inside thin-line neon HUD frames; consistent rounded neon-outline info cards and thin-line sci-fi HUD decorations; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal neon infographic elements; stable product scale and centered placement with dark breathing space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable side 3/4 hero profile and consistent product scale across the set, centered placement with dark breathing space around the product
style.surfaceSystem: dark matte display pedestal and matte charcoal panel #1A2138, subtle neon glow spill on edges
